notes: Fixes the reported crash `TypeError: float() argument must be a string or a real number, not 'AudioPipelineOutput'` at `np.asarray(audio, dtype=np.float32)`. AudioLDMPipeline now returns an AudioPipelineOutput dataclass (with .audios) instead of a bare array in this diffusers build; added `extract_waveform()` which normalises AudioPipelineOutput(.audios), dict outputs, tuples/lists (recursively unwrapped, including nested AudioPipelineOutput), CUDA tensors and numpy arrays before the float32 cast and the empty/non-finite/silent checks. Also extended the huggingface_hub shim list with CachedRepoTreeNotFoundError and huggingface_hub.errors, and added a dtype= fallback if a newer diffusers rejects torch_dtype=. All other behaviour (CUDA required else exit 78, fp16, 12 steps, guidance 2.5, 4 s default, 16 kHz per-id WAVs, index.jsonl/sound-library.jsonl/config.json/run.json with synchronized timings and RNG state, doctor, --help without model load) is unchanged.
